🧐❗️Watch out for the 'Spallettate': #Cambiaso can operate on both flanks, but #Spalletti is also evaluating him in midfield as an alternative to #DouglasLuiz. #Çelik is expected to return to the right, keeping the possibility open to play as one of the three central defenders as well. Nico #González is even more important: he can play as a wide midfielder, a winger, an attacking midfielder or a false nine.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🔛🆙 #Juventus wants to intervene in January especially in midfield, where a regista capable of dictating the tempo is lacking. The main target is #Hojbjerg: the idea would be to finance him through the exit of #Koopmeiners. Another priority is the left-back: #AitNouri is evaluated as a loan option, while #EmersonPalmieri remains in the running.[Niccolò Ceccarini - TMW via @juventusinsidernews]

As an attacking midfielder, I am convinced #Pizarro would have had less prominence compared to acting in front of the defense: there, you touch 300% more balls. In crowded and tight places, you have to tear open the gaps, just like in the penalty box today. You have to take it away from someone else. That way, #David showcased his talent more. 👨‍🦲🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'TuttoSport':BECOMING THE #JUVENTUS COACH - "At #Roma, I coached a fanbase, at Napoli you coach a city. At #Inter a tradition, with la Nazionale a nation. At #Juventus, on the other hand, you coach a mentality: it is the history of football. Here there is the #Juventus way: it is not just an impetuous emotion. It is joy, pride and responsibility: these are sentiments that never leave me alone. It is the never banal intensity of exaggerated sadness and overwhelming happiness.
